object: R0D1.q3 (a2,d2): 3-round circuit quarter-step, round 0 diagonal call 1 (1,6,11,12), a = a + b + my; d = ror(d ^ a, 8), rotation 8
question: Q1 value/count as used: how many machine ops does this quarter-step cost in the filed 595-op circuit, and what is that worth in time_log2?
number: 8 ops (add 2, and 2, or 1, shl 1, shr 1, xor 1); the plain unfolded step on the same op set is 8 ops, so constant folding removes 0. One op is worth 0.00240 bits of time_log2 (ledger: -log2(1 - 0.9944/599.1875)), so the step carries 0.0192 bits of the 125.1087. Free message words feeding the step: m10,m11.
